longest.text: Elisha sat in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. The king had sent a man ahead of him, but before the messenger arrived, Elisha said to the elders, "See how this son of a murderer sends to cut off my head? Look, when he comes, shut the door and press it against him. Isn't the sound of his master's feet behind him?"

Instead, you lifted yourself against heaven's Sovereign. You had his house's vessels brought before you, and you, your nobles, wives, and concubines drank wine from them. You praised gods of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone—gods that cannot see, hear, or know anything. But the One holding your breath in his hand, who owns all your ways—our Father—you have not honored.
